title: He Almost Killed a Girl in a Duel at His Father's Banquet . . . (Part 7)
credit: Swordmaster's Youngest Son (Hwangze Penguin / Mr. Big / AZI)

segments.say: Jin's Blade Storm rips across the arena, and the girl who dared him to this duel stands right in its *path*.
To see how it got here, go back to the Zeifl warehouse, where Jin stands over dead *golems*.
He is furious, but this is no time to *burn* with anger. He still has a mission.
Biological golems are strictly forbidden, so the Zeifls will deny everything. Jin grabs the relic stone as *proof*.
Two guard spells protect the room, one simple, one nasty. Jin picks the *craziest* way through.
He smashes fire and ice together and the whole place goes *boom*. Subtle? Never.
Back home, his sister Luna slaps two brothers to the floor for sending Jin into *Zeifl* land.
Flagbearers fight flagbearers, she snaps, so bullying a kid ten years younger is *pathetic*.
Jin walks into Storm Castle, and Gilly bursts into tears because he came back *alive*.
Then he shows her the heart of a biological *golem*. Murakhan the cat goes pale.
First a Tomb Giant, now this. He keeps the giant to himself. That cat knows too *much*.
Time skips ahead. The twins whisper Jin will become a reserve flagbearer, and he is *thrilled*.
Meanwhile the patriarch races home, because his youngest son keeps dragging him out of the Dark *Sea*.
He hoped Jin would feed his men to a white *werewolf*, but the kid beat it alone. Or did he?
At the gate he spots Jin's new swords. Ran and Vuigo admit it was a deal, and Jin *took* them.
He laughs, calls Jin cunning, and wonders if the kid is really his *son*. Dad of the year.
Then the banquet starts, and Jin is the guest of *honor* instead of a guy hiding in the shadows.
A thousand guests came, but the patriarch says they will all turn their backs once he is *gone*.
The Zeifls will crush the clan then, he says, and Jin answers calmly, I will *leave* the clan.
Then Jin asks what dirt they hold on other clans. He already read the secret job *contracts*.
A lord robbed the emperor. A lady gambled away her heirloom. The Runcandels know every *dirty* secret.
Jin says the next patriarch had better *negotiate* well, because that is the clan's future.
The Zeifls hold secrets too, but only the Runcandels get to play the *villain*.
If the next patriarch wastes all this, Jin will leave and plan his *revenge* on the Zeifls.
The old man grins. First survive, he says. Not bad, kid. His other children would only *whine*.
Then a guard runs in. Visitors with no invitation are at the gate. The *Zeifls*.
The patriarch tosses their minor patriarch Andrei out, but lets four others *in*.
Andrei grits his teeth, because defying the patriarch here means going home with no *legs*.
Then the old man raises a glass and thanks his youngest in front of a thousand *guests*.
Two rules. Brawl while drunk and you go to the *arena*. The loser concedes, the winner shows mercy.
A thousand powerful guests, and every one brought a *grudge*. Seriously, one crazy clan.
Jin can drag anyone to the arena, but if he ever loses, everything is taken away, even his *nanny*. Zero pressure.
First real talk with his dad, and Jin still wants to get *stronger* than him.
Then a loud guy named Uger slaps Jin on the head like a *puppy*.
Uger calls him a kid, and Jin smiles back, a very *dark* smile.
Jin points at the famous knights beside him. They are older than Uger, and Uger turns white and *apologizes*.
Jin forgives him politely, and Luna smirks that he has a real talent for making *enemies*.
Then she bonks his head so everyone knows he is precious to her. Nobody is *rude* to him again.
Later a white-haired girl offers him a drink. She is Siris Endorma, fifteen like him, and her smile is *too* sweet.
She clearly recognizes him, yet never brings up *Mahmeet*. Then she asks how his leg is.
He thanks the lady who put ointment on it, and she demands to know why he was at the Moonlight *Well*.
She thinks he hired a sorcerer to attack her men, and Jin shrugs that it is only an *assumption*.
So she challenges him to a duel, and Jin says he does not fight someone *weaker*. Petty. I love it.
He agrees anyway. If she wins, he talks. If he wins, she forgets she ever *saw* him.
Siris draws an ice sword, and every swing *freezes* the air, closing the gap between a four-star and a five-star.
Jin grins. He read dozens of secret tomes in Storm Castle, and he has a *hidden* move too.
Siris smiles and says it is over, then buries the arena in an *avalanche*.
But his Blade Storm comes out wilder than he meant, and Jin screams *oh no*.
Siris tries to face the storm head on, and at the last second she *ducks*.
Jin rushes over, saying he almost killed her. She shakes, because she just learned she wants to *live*.
He tells her he would have ducked too, and there is no shame in *surviving*.
She gives him ointment for the cut on his face and admits she only lived because of his *pity*.
By the deal, they are meeting for the first time *today*. See you tomorrow, he says.
Next day, Jin hunts for Zeifls his age to test his *magic*, and swears they will never mass-produce sorcerers.
Then Siris shows up cuddling his cat, and a white-haired boy leaps at Jin yelling *we finally meet*.
Jin has no idea who he is, so the guy gives hints until Jin sighs, *Veradeen* Zeifl.
Veradeen brags he is already a six-star sorcerer, and Jin knows this clown becomes the next Zeifl *patriarch*.
Then a poet named Bubarre scurries up with a pink box of love poems for Jin's sister *Luna*.
He says maybe he will call Jin his brother-in-*law*.
Jin's smile drops. His boot slams down, and he says take him to the *arena*.
The duel is hand to hand, no swords, and the poet is about to meet a *five-star*.
